result.summary: This signalized intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of markings create a high-risk environment for people on foot.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no designated, visible path to cross this wide intersection, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians must rely on vehicular signals, which may not provide adequate clearance time or clear indication of when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the roadway surface can create tripping hazards or uneven surfaces for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. Parked vehicles near the crossing may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked cars on the left side of the street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway, upstream of the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and make pedestrians more visible to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and traffic signals within a residential context. However, the use of low-visibility crosswalk markings and wide corner radii suggests a design that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Low-visibility crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The standard parallel-line crosswalk markings are less visible to approaching motorists than high-visibility continental designs.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible across the side street on the right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide curb radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for higher-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing markings to continental or ladder-style patterns to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install or ensure the presence of pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features signalized crossings with marked crosswalks and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical separation like refuge islands or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic on the main road without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide curb radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry may allow vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing the wide main road.

interventions.description: Upgrade the faint parallel line crosswalks to high-visibility zebra or continental markings.
